blocks.text: Television host Bianca Gonzalez Intal addressed fans of “Pinoy Big Brother” (PBB) to clarify how the reality show supports housemates right after eviction. In a post on X on Saturday, Nov. 14, Gonzalez explained the step-by-step transition process before evictees return to the outside world. She wrote the message amid the bashing that the show and evictees are getting from followers of the show.
